summary: Join our Data Privacy and Security Training Course to master the principles of data protection. Equip yourself with vital skills for a secure digital environmen
lede: Data privacy training helps professionals who handle personal information map how it is collected, used, shared, and protected. It is designed for privacy, security, risk, and technology teams that need a consistent way to manage personal data across its lifecycle, with practice creating data inventories, mapping processing, and assessing privacy risks. Learners also explore access controls, supplier safeguards, and breach response planning, producing practical records and plans for workplace use.
audienceIntro: Data Privacy and Security Training suits professionals who manage personal information, security controls, risk evidence, technology operations, or privacy-related reporting. It supports foundation-level learners and experienced practitioners who need a common operating method across privacy and information security teams.
prerequisites: You need a working understanding of how your organization collects, stores, shares, and deletes information. No coding or software development experience is required. Bring a laptop if you want to adapt the provided data inventory, risk register, control matrix, and improvement roadmap templates to your own environment, but do not use live confidential or personal data during exercises.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
